_comment: Secondary capacity descriptor for N6 reflexive tests.

objective.name: sample.normalize
objective.description: Normalize a record-like payload into a canonical shape

#root.role: Normalize one record-like input into a canonical payload shape.

transformation_contract.morphing: An inbound record becomes a canonical normalized representation with an explicit field count.
invariants: sample.normalize must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sample.normalize returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sample.normalize fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.

resolution._comment: Seed descriptor used for reflexive meaning tests; runtime execution is not asserted from this descriptor alone.
